open_questions: RUWE 1.043 and rv_amplitude 18.21 are elevated - RV follow-up needed to fully rule out an eccentric stellar binary masquerading as spots, but spot-harmonic coincidence explains the data without it.
dossier.public_summary: The 1.24-day dip matches the star's own 1.24-day spot rotation almost exactly, with spot brightness swings as big as half the dip depth. The measured depth swings by up to 4x from transit to transit and from sector to sector, and odd and even dips differ, as expected when spots change which parts of the star are eclipsed. This is stellar variability leaking into the light curve, not a transiting planet.

reasons.why: Large modulation at the dip period (ratio ~0.55 vs depth ~11970 ppm) with very high chi2, much larger than typical planetary phase curve. Points to stellar variability/binarity leaking into the dip measurement, not a planet alone.

Dip period is exactly the star's strong spot period (false_alarm 0e+000) in 7 of 8 sectors, with spot amplitudes of 95542 to 125343 ppm. This is the classic signature of spots/rotation contaminating a 1.24 d signal.
reasons.value: rotation_d 1.24, signal_period_d 1.24108, signal_over_rotation 1.0008709677419354, amplitude_ppm up to 125343

reasons.why: Odd and even transits differ at 4.3 sigma with opposite sign in different sectors (sector_oe_max_sigma 15.85, sectors_over_3 3), inconsistent with a planet's equal depths and pointing to either a binary at twice the period or spot-phase effects.

Depth changes within SPOC 2-min and within TESS-SPOC (sector_depths_by_source verdict changes_within_a_source, p_constant 0). Changes co-incide with the ~1.24 d spot cycle (spot amplitude varies sector to sector), not expected for a stable planet.

Individual transit depths are highly inconsistent with a constant depth; one transit is 4x deeper. Combined with centroid on_target (verdict on_target offset 0.3056 arcsec) and zero plausible neighbours, variation is on the target and best explained by spot-crossing/stellar activity, not a blended binary.
reasons.value: p_consistent 0.0, chi2 3992.99 dof 124, outlier at epoch 643 depth_ppm 42808 sigma 26.3
